newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar seen searching for direction in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Dollar seen searching for direction in Asia.

text.p: The dollar is expected to search for clear direction in Asian trade on Monday, with the market waiting for the release of Japan's customs-cleared trade data for July at 8.50 a.m. (2350 GMT Sunday), dealers said.
The market will also be watching moves in Japanese stocks and money market rates. Weak stocks and low bond yields may keep dollar well-supported against yen on the downside, dealers said.
"We will watch the trade data first. But since trade issues have not been the main focus of the market, the impact from the data is likely to be limited," a trust bank dealer said.
